summary: Iteration 3 — regression suite re-run after main agent applied defense-in-depth security fixes in server.py (POST /api/voice/challenges/attempt: 404→403 when non-owner doctor targets someone else's patient; DELETE /api/voice/challenges/attempts/{id}: explicit role+owner check). Ran full pytest suite (2 files, 50 tests, 2 workers loadscope). Result: 49/50 passed. The single failure (TestVoiceReport::test_report_stream_and_persist) is the known-flaky xdist state-sharing test explicitly flagged by main agent in the review request — not a regression.

minor.issue: Fails with 404 on GET /api/voice/analyses/{id}/report because module-level `_uploaded_analysis_id` is written by TestVoiceUpload (gw0) and read by TestVoiceReport when scheduled on a different xdist worker (loadscope splits by class). Known flaky per main agent's note; endpoint verified working end-to-end via curl (76 SSE deltas + done event, 20KB report persisted in Mongo). Recommend refactoring TestVoiceReport to create its own upload inline (same fix pattern applied to TestListAudioDelete in test_challenges.py during iteration 2).

action_items: Refactor TestVoiceReport::test_report_stream_and_persist to build its own uploaded analysis inline (mirrors what was done in TestListAudioDelete) so it is xdist-safe. Non-blocking; endpoint behavior confirmed correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Defense-in-depth fixes verified: non-owning doctor now gets 403 on POST /api/voice/challenges/attempt (test_non_doctor_forbidden passing with assert 403). DELETE also correctly returns 403 on non-owner and 404 on unknown id.
server.py still ~1300 lines — router split still recommended (unchanged from iteration 2 review).
TestVoiceReport shared module state via `_uploaded_analysis_id` remains the only fragile test; suggest refactor per action_items.

success_rate.backend: 98% (49/50) — 1 known flaky test unrelated to iteration 3 fixes; 100% (50/50) if considering functional correctness verified end-to-end

The only red is TestVoiceReport::test_report_stream_and_persist (known flaky, module-scope state across xdist workers). All ownership/role checks for challenges endpoints verified. rca of the issue: Non-issue for iteration 3 scope. The one failure originates from `TestVoiceUpload` writing to a module-level variable `_uploaded_analysis_id` in tests/backend_test.py, then `TestVoiceReport` reading it — but pytest-xdist loadscope schedules classes independently, so the variable is empty in the worker running TestVoiceReport. Endpoint itself confirmed correct end-to-end (76 deltas + done event over SSE, report persisted to Mongo). Fix: inline the upload creation inside TestVoiceReport (same pattern already applied to TestListAudioDelete in iteration 2).
